package.name: moveit2_extended_rviz
package.description:
RViz panel for running and watching Objectives.
Deliberately the same controls as the web Studio -- pick an Objective, fill in its parameters, run it, watch the tree light up, answer it when a Behavior stops to ask something -- so that anyone who already has RViz open for the robot does not have to open a browser as well.
Depends only on moveit2_extended_msgs, not on the core library: the panel reads the server over ROS interfaces, so it does not drag BehaviorTree.CPP, pluginlib loaders or MoveIt into the RViz process.
